question: Can a quantity measured before the A-only curriculum predict familywise variation in the later random-rank transfer slope, including seed-dependent sign instability?

historical_selector_data.widths: all H=32/48/64/96/128 cells already observed before this protocol; no post-2026-09-03 outcomes
historical_selector_data.role: candidate selection only; not confirmatory evidence

outcome: r_{s,H,f}: OLS slope of target25-minus-A_nat 80-20 performance-aligned span versus keep_dim. More negative means stronger rank-dependent transfer benefit.

candidate_predictors.pre_rotation_gap: Before any A-only curriculum, install the same rho=.25 aligned B head used by the rank experiment. On the fixed target-B evaluation batch, compute B_NLL(keep0 full state-coordinate rotation) - B_NLL(keep12 identity).
candidate_predictors.state_effective_rank: Effective rank exp(-sum_i p_i log p_i), p_i=s_i^2/sum_j s_j^2, from singular values of the 12x32 base state-embedding matrix before curriculum.
candidate_predictors.B_hidden_effective_rank: Effective rank of centered token-level GRU hidden states on the fixed target-B evaluation batch before curriculum, using identity B coordinates and the aligned B head; p_i from squared singular values.
candidate_predictors.initial_B_state_grad_norm: L2 norm of gradient of target-B NLL with respect to the base state-embedding weight on the fixed target-B evaluation batch before curriculum, identity B coordinates, aligned B head.

candidate_selection: Within every historical (seed,width) block, center each candidate and r across its five families. Pool the centered cells and compute Spearman rho(candidate,r). Select the candidate with largest absolute rho; ties within 1e-12 use the listed candidate order. Freeze prediction direction to sign of that historical rho. No multivariate model or additional feature engineering is allowed.
fresh_primary_statistic: On the 50 fresh cells, center selected predictor and r within each of the 10 (seed,width) five-family blocks. Compute pooled Spearman rho. Direction-adjusted rho = historical_sign * fresh_rho.
fresh_permutation_test: Within each fresh (seed,width) block independently permute the five centered predictor values, recompute pooled direction-adjusted Spearman rho, and estimate a one-sided p-value with exactly 100000 Monte Carlo permutations using NumPy PCG64 seed 20260903; p=(1+#perm_stat>=observed)/(100001).
primary_pass: at least 7 of the 10 fresh (seed,width) blocks have within-block Spearman sign matching the frozen historical direction
stopping: Exactly the five listed fresh seeds and two widths; no rescue seeds, candidate additions, multivariate combinations, threshold changes, or family exclusions.
interpretation_if_pass: Evidence that a pre-curriculum learner-state quantity predicts part of the learner-conditioned variation in shared-coordinate transfer geometry in this synthetic GRU family.
interpretation_if_fail: Do not claim a simple one-number pre-state predictor from these four candidates; retain learner dependence as established descriptively but mechanistically unresolved at this reduction level.
